Simon Maxam (Radoya) is a founder and designer working across identity, interaction design, and software. His practice is shaped by a fascination with systems, spatial interfaces, and moments of delight. He runs Radoya, a Canadian studio building private, on-device AI and the worlds around it. He works with people and teams who challenge the status quo and believe good enough is not enough. To discuss a collaboration, reach him on LinkedIn or Instagram.
